description: Defines the class 'downlink_processor_multi_executor_state' for managing the internal state of an upper PHY downlink processor in a multi-executor environment, including state transitions and PDU processing notifications.

classes.name: downlink_processor_multi_executor_state
classes.description: Manages the internal state of the downlink processor, including reserving resources, handling PDU processing states, and stopping the processor.

methods.name: reserve_on_resource_grid_configure
methods.description: Reserves the downlink processor when configuring the resource grid, transitioning to accepting PDUs if idle.

methods.name: on_finish_requested
methods.description: Indicates that all PDUs have been queued and no more are accepted, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: on_grid_sent
methods.description: Signals that the resource grid has been sent, transitioning the processor to idle.

methods.name: on_task_creation
methods.description: Notifies the creation of a new PDU processing task, incrementing the pending PDU count.

methods.name: on_task_completion
methods.description: Notifies completion of a PDU processing task, decrementing the pending PDU count and indicating if the grid can be sent.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the finite state machine by transitioning to the stopped state.
